messages:
maria_marketing: Quick sync — Echo Labs case study: interview scheduled tomorrow 11am PT with their CPO. Need to lock quote approval + legal clearance by EOD Thu so we can hit next-week launch window. Who can own transcript, short clips, and the webinar tie-in?

leo_growth: I can take lead on the webinar slotting and inbound routing once we have the final quote. Can we target Tues webinar slot (internal approval dependent)?

tara_content: I'll own transcript + highlight clips. Plan to auto-generate ASR then do a 1-pass human clean. Need interview audio file by EOD tomorrow.

josh_se: I can drop the raw recording into the shared drive right after the call. Will tag with meeting ID and timestamps.

annie_prod: Promo checklist idea — short quote for hero, 2 social snippets, 1 benchmark callout, and a 30s clip for demo page. Do we have permission to use their logo?

maria_marketing: Yes, Echo Labs confirmed logo usage in Slack DM but legal still needs to sign off on quote wording. Annie, can you draft hero + 2 snippets by Fri morning?

legal_team: Quick heads-up — legal needs the exact quoted text and context. If quote references metrics, we need source backing or anonymize. Send quote + any benchmark claims to legal-review@redwood.com. We usually need 48 hours for standard review.

tara_content: Noted. I'll mark any benchmark lines as [CLAIM: pending backing] in the transcript. Also planning to pull a 10-phrase prompt/answer pair to use as a benchmark blurb — will mark in the doc.

leo_growth: For inbound leads: once we publish, I'll add an automated Nurture flow that routes leads from Echo Labs demo page to the Demo SDR queue and tags them with campaign=echo-case. Need final publish URL by Tues EOD.

maria_marketing: Tagging timeline: interview tomorrow -> raw audio in drive same day -> transcript + clips by Fri AM -> legal sign-off by Fri EOD -> assets for marketing + webinar seed by Mon. Is that realistic?

josh_se: Yes for the audio. I'll include a small README with filenames and the meeting log.

annie_prod: Drafting hero copy now. Two quick options: 
1) "Echo Labs scales ML inference 3x while cutting per-token cost by 40%"
2) "Echo Labs: faster inference, smaller bill — a Redwood Inference case study"
Which should we send to legal for phrasing?

legal_team: Send option 2 for branding approval, option 1 needs metric source. If Echo Labs can provide a simple one-line method/period (e.g., "over Q4 2025 vs prior infra") we can accept. Otherwise we'll push a qualitative claim.

promo-bot: Reminder: embargo window set to 2026-03-30 08:00 PDT for customer assets if legal clears by 2026-03-28 17:00.

maria_marketing: OK — Tara, please add the [CLAIM: source needed] tag and ping Echo Labs to confirm the 3x/40% numbers during the interview. Leo, I'll loop you in on the confirmation so you can plan the nurture content.

leo_growth: Got it. Also, can someone produce a 1-line moderator intro for the webinar promo? Short and punchy.

tara_content: I'll draft the moderator intro + two social variations and add to the shared doc after cleaning transcript.

annie_prod: Upload checklist (quick copy):
```
- raw audio -> /marketing/assets/echo/2026-03-xx/raw.wav
- transcript -> /marketing/assets/echo/2026-03-xx/echo-transcript.md
- hero quote -> marketing/echo/hero.txt
- clips -> marketing/echo/clips/ (30s, 60s, 90s)
- logo -> marketing/echo/logo/ (SVG, PNG)
- legal notes -> marketing/echo/legal-review.md
- publish URL -> TBD
```

maria_marketing: Perfect. I'll create the shared folder and invite legal_team + leo_growth + tara_content + josh_se. Can someone take a minute to confirm the interview slide we want them to see (one-slide checklist) so the moderator isn't scrambling?

josh_se: I'll drop the slide in the folder after interview — simple: 3 bullets (key outcomes, ask/CTA, demo link).

legal_team: Also request: if the quote mentions specific customer names (their partners), we need Echo Labs' permission to publish those partner names.

maria_marketing: Understood. I'll ask Echo Labs and add a small permission form into the onboarding doc.

leo_growth: Final note — if legal requires redactions and it delays sign-off, we should still plan a soft launch (blog + social) and hold the webinar promo until cleared. Let's avoid blocking lead routing for the whole campaign.

maria_marketing: Good call. I'll set the publish workflow so blog/social are separate tasks from webinar registration emails. Thanks team — will update thread after the interview with raw file link and timecodes for clips.
